summary: Yueda Digital Holding filed a Form 6-K reporting shareholder votes at its extraordinary general meeting held June 12, 2026. Shareholders approved a share capital reduction reducing par value from US$4.00 to US$0.0001 per share, a subdivision of authorized but unissued shares, a cancellation of excess authorized shares, and a subsequent increase of authorized capital back to US$40,000,000. These are ordinary corporate capital restructuring actions, not a special situation such as a buyout, reorganization, or going-private transaction. No deal terms, premium, or strategic change are present.
